body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Berlin, Germany. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 4 km. It starts at German Spy Museum, Leipziger Pl. 9, 10117 Berlin, Germany. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to German Spy Museum. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Dive into Berlin's layered history with this Self-Guided Audio Tour, perfect for those keen on uncovering the city's past from espionage to monumental ruins. Your ticket to the German Spy Museum is included, setting you on a path right from espionage's intriguing world to the pinnacles of German history.
>
> (!) Please note that while the ticket to the German Spy Museum is included, an in-app audio guide for this museum is not provided, inviting you to fully immerse in the ambiance of the artifacts and stories therein.
>
> The tour begins at the German Spy Museum, located at Leipziger Platz, a site that symbolizes the epicentre of Berlin’s historical division and the fault line of the Cold War. From there, you will make your way through various landmarks, including Potsdamer Platz, Tiergarten Park, the Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe, the Brandenburg Gate, the Reichstag Building, and many more. The tour concludes at the Red City Hall of Berlin, a historic building that reflects the city’s medieval origins and its evolution over the centuries.
>
> Along the way, you will experience the vibrant and modern urban landscape of Potsdamer Platz, the peaceful retreat of Tiergarten Park, and the somber reflection of the Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe. You will also witness the iconic Brandenburg Gate, the historic Reichstag Building, and the majestic Berlin Cathedral.

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €31.05. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 65 ratings and 51 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.
